title: Database import does not complete successfully due to incorrect SQLite database corruption error
body:
I ran into an issue today when re-installing the xDrip app and loading a previous database backup. It appears that the process of importing from a full database backup does not successfully complete.

From looking at `/data/user/0/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip/databases` on the device's filesystem with `adb shell` and `run-as com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip`, it appears that the entire database file doesn't get copied over, as the size of the files in that directory don't end up reaching the full size of the original database import.

comments.body: @jwoglom Please provide your full environment as described in the [bug report template](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/blob/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug-report.md) including the available RAM and free disk space of your phone.
Is the version of xDrip, importing, the same as the version of xDrip that exported the settings?
Just wanted to belatedly mention -- I tested loading in a backup on the latest release for an unrelated reason and the error didn't occur. Will reply if I notice it again.

I noticed this issue again. The root cause appears to be
```
10-15 00:35:42.484 31312 31497 W SQLiteLog: (28) file unlinked while open: /data/user/0/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip/databases/DexDrip.db
10-15 00:35:42.485 31312 31497 W SQLiteLog: (28) file unlinked while open: /data/user/0/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip/databases/DexDrip.db
10-15 00:35:42.486 31312 31497 W SQLiteLog: (28) file unlinked while open: /data/user/0/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip/databases/DexDrip.db
```

which appears because the database is closed _after_ renaming the imported backup to the sqlite database file, causing a race condition which seems to appear more frequently the larger the size of your database. I am opening a PR to resolve this issue.
